allocationRules.resourceIdentity: Stable native usage or CI run/job identity plus dimension/provider/accountingScope; deduplicate before allocation.
allocationRules.tokenSemantics: total = input + output; cachedInput is an input subset, reasoning an output subset; cacheWriteInput separate, never added to native total without a provider definition.
allocationRules.conservation: Each source amount is allocated by exact rational shares; sum shares <= 1. Remainder is unallocated; do not duplicate shared CI or round before aggregation.
allocationRules.purposes: Exclusive per resource unit. Supported split shares may populate purposes; unsupported mixed/unclassified remains unknown. Repair/activity/cause views intersect these buckets and are not additive.
allocationRules.avoidable: Only observed or supported-inference claim with evidence and feasible then-permitted alternative enters numerator; hypotheses excluded. Required duplicate checks remain required.
allocationRules.causeCost: One episode amount counted once under supported exclusive primary cause. Contributing causes are nonexclusive counts, not additive costs.
allocationRules.time: Observed span sum is separate from elapsed union clipped to witnessed item window. Wait union separate; overlaps explicit. Missing span time is unknown, never inferred wait. Critical-path claims need witnessed dependency coverage.

enqueue.effect: Atomic insert-or-readback of same stable request key and exact evidence/subject/policy. Same key/different bytes conflicts; existing current request returns without resetting state/budget.

claim.effect: Atomic pending→claimed compare-and-swap over current revision+contentDigest under authenticated eligible producer. Reserve cross-scope item-epoch invocation budget and bind actually witnessed expected-dispatch custody in same transaction before model call. Actual invocationRef may be null until spawn/start observation; reserved dispatch is not native admission. Identical claim retry reads same receipt; alternate/stale claim refuses.

settle.effect: Atomic claimed→settled/failed/unavailable CAS with current claimId/authenticated producer. Resolve actual invocationRef through existing expected-dispatch→invocation-lineage/runtime-admission once started; completed/failed requires that actual join. Unknown missing invocation remains explicit with no retry. Result binds same admitted assessment subject/digest/policy; stale result cannot replace newer state.

inspect.effect: Read canonical state+revision+contentDigest, nullable model/claim/invocation, applied receipt/acceptedAt, result and budget; missing key explicitly unavailable, not empty success.

attach-invocation.effect: CAS over same current claim/revision/digest and authenticated producer/owner/generation; resolve exact expected-dispatch→invocation-lineage/runtime-admission matching actual invocation. Atomically bind existing invocation without a new call, new budget or revision epoch. Conflicting/stale attachment refuses; identical retry reads same receipt.

analysisLifecycle.authority: Enqueue requires current effective item/outcome, immutable snapshot and enrolled authenticated producer. Native scope additionally resolves existing root-admitted item review plus expected lineage, terminal and qualified usage witness refs. Provisional scope resolves source delivery without fabricated root review/terminal evidence. Claim/settle reuse this authority and actual existing producer association; supplied strings are not grants.
analysisLifecycle.unselectedModel: Pending request modelAlias/claimant/invocation/claimId are null, never fabricated model provenance. Output assessment with selected analyst remains a separate record.
analysisLifecycle.budget: Existing one invocation per snapshot; one initial plus at most two automatic evidence revision invocation reservations per item/outcome epoch across native/provisional scopes, not per request. Null epoch pools by item/outcome identity until witnessed resolution; joining known epoch carries consumed reservations, never resets them.
analysisLifecycle.budgetCharge: Claim atomically reserves before dispatch. Failed and unknown invoked calls consume original budget; no automatic retry after an unknown started effect. Restart reconciles original invocation/receipt first. Only authenticated exact original invocation evidence proving no effect can release/reassign unused reservation under CAS; it is not a new retry allowance.
analysisLifecycle.finalization: Settlement result must be the admitted assessment for same subject/snapshot/policy/claim. Late usage updates deterministic metrics without triggering analyst loops or adding outcomes. Invalid/missing result remains explicit failed/partial without altering delivery.
analysisLifecycle.rollback: Disable further enqueue/claim while retaining pending state, failures, usage, source facts and prior results; existing delivery and correction authority continue.
analysisLifecycle.nativeStartBoundary: Existing begin publishes expected-dispatch before spawn; actual started publishes invocation-lineage/runtime-admission afterwards. Claim binds witnessed dispatch/prospective custody before call, not fabricated native admission. Lost claim-to-start is unknown until native reconciliation; cannot automatically relaunch.
analysisLifecycle.limitSupport: Claim discloses inputTokens/outputTokens/seconds support per limit as enforced, unavailable or observed-only against selected existing provider route. Missing enforcement never appears as a hard cap. Settled actual usage/timing can qualify that specific bounded invocation, not a universal token guarantee. Required unavailable limits fence dependent execution under existing authority; do not silently substitute providers.
